# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen when returning to school, around sixteen by the end of the volume  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P24](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall boy with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. As he grows older, he is described as tall, handsome, and manly with a splendid chin.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037)_

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, ambitious, and quick-witted, possessing a strong determination to excel in his studies. He is cheerful, teasing, and confident, though capable of deep contriteness and self-sacrifice when he realizes he has wronged someone. He holds himself to high personal standards, demonstrating generosity, maturity, and a desire to help others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## History

Four years prior to attending Avonlea school, Gilbert moved to Alberta for three years with his sick father, missing much schooling. After spending a summer in New Brunswick, he returns to Avonlea and resumes his studies. On his first afternoon back, he teases Anne Shirley by pulling her braid and calling her "Carrots," resulting in Anne smashing a slate over his head; despite taking the blame and apologizing, Anne refuses to speak to him. He engages in an academic rivalry with Anne, competing for the top of the class. Later, he rescues Anne from a bridge pile when her flat sinks during a game of Elaine, but she rejects his offer of friendship once again. At Queen's Academy, he studies for a First Class teacher's license, earning the prestigious Gold Medal upon graduation. Finding that his father cannot afford college, he plans to teach at Avonlea, but voluntarily gives up the position to Anne so she can stay at Green Gables with Marilla, taking a post at White Sands instead. Anne finally thanks him, and the two agree to become close friends.
